test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select "No error’.

When I asked her / how she came to be at the window / she shook her head and turns away.

options.text: she shook her head and turns away.
how she came to be at the window

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect tense usage in **"she shook her head and turns away."**
 
• The verb tenses should match. Since "shook" is past tense, "turns" should also be in past tense.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"she shook her head and turned away."**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"When I asked her how she came to be at the window, **she shook her head and turned away.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "When I asked her"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 3.
 
• **Option 4: "how she came to be at the window"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
